nodes.label: Multi-Dimensional Parameter Scanning
nodes.rationale: Grid searches or Sobol sequences across ILI weights, buy/sell percentiles, and cooldown period. Prevents overfitting to single narrow optimum.

nodes.label: Riemann Zeta Discrete Monitoring Correction
nodes.rationale: Continuous-to-discrete barrier adjustment using beta = -zeta(1/2)/sqrt(2*pi) ~ 0.5826. Corrects bias from sampling continuous liquidity at discrete points.

nodes.label: Return Gap Performance Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: ReturnGap = InvestorGrossReturn - HoldingsReturn. Separates interim trading skill from static holdings returns. Measures execution alpha.

nodes.label: Stressed Market Condition (SMC) Scenarios
nodes.rationale: MiFID II SMC scenarios: Message Spikes (10x tick volume), Volatility Jumps (>5% in 5 min), Capacity Exhaustion. OTR monitoring with circuit breaker < 100ms latency.

nodes.label: DeRoundingFilter and TimePeriodicityFilter
nodes.rationale: DeRoundingFilter smooths volume spikes at round time marks caused by human programmer bias (SSRN-2375739). TimePeriodicityFilter adjusts 1-second algorithmic loop artifacts (SSRN-2496669).

nodes.label: Submission-Based Price Impact KPI
nodes.rationale: Tiered cost model: Passive 0.84 bps, Aggressive 2.03 bps, Large orders 9.04 bps. NBBO midpoint drift simulation for 10-second post-submission horizon (SSRN-3497001).

nodes.label: Reproducibility Disclosure Score (RDS)
nodes.rationale: 0-2 rubric for quantifying disclosure quality of all models. Tracks code version (git SHA), dataset hash, model hyperparameters. Aligns with regulatory-defensible deployment requirements.
